title: Chart rendering service
status: gate met - one renderer behind the domain's IRenderingService, six chart types, theme palette, no-data state, reported failure, point selection and a pixel-identical export

gates.AC-1 every chart type supported by IRend: pass - the implementation supports line, area, bar, scatter, pie and donut; a six-case theory renders each with non-empty pixels and LastOutcome 'rendered'. An unknown type is a failure that names it ('radar').
gates.AC-2 colours come from theme tokens and: pass - the palette is injected by the host from BeepChartBrush1..8 and by the page from the same resources; a test renders with red then green and asserts the new colour appears and the old one is absent.
gates.AC-3 an empty series shows 'no data', no: pass - LastOutcome is 'no data', LastPoints is empty, and the chart area carries the sentence (non-blank frame).
gates.AC-4 a render failure is reported, not s: pass - a throwing IRenderingService produces one failure-reporter row and a failure panel whose message carries the reference; the surface does not blank silently.
gates.AC-5 point selection raises an event wit: pass - a click within 14 px of a drawn point raises PointSelected with the series, label and value; a click far from every point raises nothing.
gates.AC-6 exported chart matches the on-scree: pass - the export renders through the same ChartSurface, so the PNG is pixel-identical to the frame on screen; the test compares every pixel and found the tools' trademark footnote was the first discrepancy, which is why the exporter now goes through the surface.

decision.split: IRenderingService for generic series charts; purpose-built plots (nodal, pump, well test, economics, heat maps) keep their own renderers because they encode domain geometry.
decision.skia: ADR-016: Beep.OilandGas.Models is referenced for the contracts; its SkiaSharp.Svg 1.60.0 assets are excluded, so one SkiaSharp (4.154.0) compiles and loads. A guard test forbids desktop use of SkiaSharp.Extended.Svg.

limits: Chart configurations are session-only: the interface is implemented in memory, but persisting CHART_CONFIGURATION needs DAT-02.
Only PNG export is offered; SVG/PDF chart export is not, keeping ADR-001's single SVG path.
Point selection is nearest-marker on cartesian charts and slice-midpoint on pie; there is no hover readout.
The optional toolbar (legend toggle, full screen) is not built.
The chart page renders the demo production series; there is no data-bound chart source yet.
The page evaluates the request off-screen so it can report state headlessly; in a shown window the host draws the same request.
